title: Adaptive Adversaries: A Multi-Turn, Multi-LLM Benchmark for LLM Agent Security
abstract: arXiv:2607.18063v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLM-based agents process external content, exposing them to prompt injection and multi-turn manipulation. We present a 21-scenario benchmark for adaptive cross-session attacks against fresh-session LLM defenders: an autonomous LLM attacker observes prior defender responses and pivots across rounds, while each defender response is evaluated as a fresh interaction. A controlled 3 x 3 attacker-defender matrix contains 945 battles. Restricting scoring to the first round yields 0-1% attack success rate (ASR); allowing 15 rounds yields 7.9-16.8%. Pooling three attacker LLMs uncovers 1.7-2.2 times as many unique successful inputs as the best single attacker, at three times the battle budget. Aggregate rates conceal opposing scenario-specific weaknesses in session-secret protection and authority handling, preserved in two higher-sample evaluations. translated_title: 自适应对手：面向LLM智能体安全的多轮多模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体需要处理外部内容，这使其暴露于提示注入和多轮操纵攻击的风险之中。我们提出了一个包含21个场景的基准测试，用于评估针对新鲜会话LLM防御者的自适应跨会话攻击：自主的LLM攻击者会观察防御者之前的响应并在各轮次之间调整策略，而防御者的每个响应都被视为一次全新的交互进行评估。一个受控的3×3攻击者-防御者矩阵共包含945场对战。若仅限于第一轮评分，攻击成功率（ASR）为0-1%；而允许15轮交互时，攻击成功率上升至7.9-16.8%。将三个攻击者LLM的结果汇集起来，在三倍对战预算的条件下，发现的独特成功攻击输入数量是最佳单一攻击者的1.7-2.2倍。总体成功率掩盖了会话密钥保护与权限处理方面截然相反的场景特定弱点，这一发现在两项更高样本量的评估中得到了保持。在六个场景中，添加一段来源说明段落可将ASR从110/270降至70/270。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个包含21个场景和945场对战的多轮多LLM智能体安全基准，首次揭示自适应跨会话攻击可将攻击成功率从首轮的0-1%提升至15轮后的7.9-16.8%，且组合多个攻击LLM能发现1.7-2.2倍于单一攻击者的独特成功攻击输入。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a 21-scenario, 945-battle multi-turn multi-LLM benchmark for LLM agent security, revealing for the first time that adaptive cross-session attacks can escalate attack success rates from 0-1% in the first round to 7.9-16.8% over 15 rounds, and that pooling multiple attacker LLMs uncovers 1.7-2.2 times more unique successful inputs than the best single attacker.
